title: Little Dima and Equation
statementMd:
Little Dima misbehaved during a math lesson a lot and the nasty teacher Mr. Pickles gave him the following problem as a punishment.

Find all integer solutions $*x*$ $(0 < *x* < 10^{9})$ of the equation:

$*x* = *b*·*s*(*x*)^{*a*} + *c*,$

where $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$ are some predetermined constant values and function $*s*(*x*)$ determines the sum of all digits in the decimal representation of number $*x*$.

The teacher gives this problem to Dima for each lesson. He changes only the parameters of the equation: $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$. Dima got sick of getting bad marks and he asks you to help him solve this challenging problem.

## Input

The first line contains three space-separated integers: $*a*, *b*, *c*$ $(1 ≤ *a* ≤ 5; 1 ≤ *b* ≤ 10000;  - 10000 ≤ *c* ≤ 10000)$.

## Output

Print integer $*n*$ — the number of the solutions that you've found. Next print $*n*$ integers in the increasing order — the solutions of the given equation. Print only integer solutions that are larger than zero and strictly less than $10^{9}$.
statementZhMd:
小迪马在数学课上经常调皮捣蛋，因此坏老师 Pickles 先生给了他下面这道题作为惩罚。

求方程的所有整数解 $*x*$ $(0 < *x* < 10^{9})$：

$*x* = *b*·*s*(*x*)^{*a*} + *c*,$

其中 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$ 是预先确定的常数，函数 $*s*(*x*)$ 表示数字 $*x*$ 的十进制表示中所有数位之和。

老师每节课都会给 Dima 出这道题，只改变方程的参数：$*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$。Dima 已经厌倦了不断拿低分，因此请你帮助他解决这个具有挑战性的问题。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数：$*a*, *b*, *c*$ $(1 ≤ *a* ≤ 5; 1 ≤ *b* ≤ 10000;  - 10000 ≤ *c* ≤ 10000)$。

## 输出格式

输出整数 $*n*$——你找到的解的数量。接下来按递增顺序输出 $*n*$ 个整数——给定方程的解。只输出大于零且严格小于 $10^{9}$ 的整数解。
